ShlinkAPIKeyCredential.title: Shlink API Key
ShlinkAPIKeyCredential.x-credential-instructions: Supply an existing raw API key and one public HTTPS Shlink instance. X-Api-Key header only; fixed /rest/v3. No key issue, refresh, Basic/Bearer or host/version fallback. Catalog access is not actor or instance ownership. Key role coverage, entitlement and parity with software v5.1.7 remain unverified.
